Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [/page/1/Text/7] Leading a purposeful life not only beneits one's well-being, but also bufers against potential sufering. Indeed, studies have demonstrated that having identiied a purpose in life was predictive of greater life satisfaction for adolescents and adults (Bronk, Hill, Lapsley, Talib, & Finch, 2009; Bronk, Riches, & Mangan, 2018; Burrow & Hill, 2011; Ryf, 1989). An inverse link between purpose identiication and depressive symptoms was also supported by studies utilizing diferent purpose measures across various ethnic and demographic backgrounds of participants (Bronk et al., 2018; Liu, Shono, & Kitamura, 2009; Ryf, 1989; Ryf & Keyes, 1995; Scheier et al., 2006; Shek, 1992).
